full_details: Heminges paid the inn thirteen shillings and fourpence, and the host named Michaelmas if my lord writes again. The trestles stayed stacked. Garnish carried the books himself. At the Theatre door Nick asked whether the stage was truly twice the inn's, and you had not paced it, so you gave him no number. Nobody looked back. In the evening the copper took galls, copperas and gum, and the horn you paid twopence for on Saturday is still the one on the desk. The nine lines are not in the book. The Rose's bill did not come into the day.
one_sentence: You walked the baskets up to the Theatre behind an eightpenny cart, and left Kemp's nine lines at home, still in your own hand.
title: The company left the Cross Keys
